name: Anis Belkacem
milestone_by_age_26: Co-created MEE6 in 2016, the world's most popular Discord bot (22M+ servers), and built it into a profitable bootstrapped multimillion-dollar business with co-founder Brendan Rius by age 26.
starting_point: Born around 1997 in France; started coding at 12 and launched 20+ websites as a teenager with no documented family tech background.
current_position: Co-founder and Co-CEO of MEE6, the world's most popular Discord bot; bootstrapped multimillion-dollar business based in Paris.

trajectory.title: Started programming
trajectory.description: Began learning to code at age 12 in France, inspired by tech industry giants and the belief that anyone with technical skills could make a global impact.

trajectory.title: Launched 20+ websites as a teenager
trajectory.description: Honed skills through constant experimentation, launching over 20 websites during his teenage years and practicing rapid product iteration.

trajectory.title: Dropped out of college
trajectory.description: Realized he was learning more from his own projects than from classes. Committed to launching one new product every two weeks to keep improving his skills.

trajectory.title: Co-founded MEE6 with Brendan Rius
trajectory.description: Built an all-in-one Discord bot bundling moderation, engagement, role management, and custom commands into one user-friendly platform. Launched after 3 days of intense coding.

trajectory.title: Rapid traction — 480k unique users
trajectory.description: Gained initial traction by directly messaging big Discord server owners. The bot's user-friendly design and all-in-one approach resonated, quickly reaching 480k unique users.

trajectory.title: Bootstrapped through free cloud trials
trajectory.description: When server costs outpaced subscription revenue, kept infrastructure alive by cycling through free cloud trials from different providers, migrating everything each time one expired.

trajectory.title: Reached millions of Discord servers
trajectory.description: MEE6 grew to become one of the most widely deployed community tools on the internet, trusted by millions of Discord servers worldwide.

trajectory.title: Scaled to 22M+ servers, 45 employees
trajectory.description: MEE6 reached 22M+ Discord servers with 45 employees and multimillion-dollar annual revenue — entirely bootstrapped, never venture-backed.

trajectory.title: Co-CEO of profitable bootstrapped business
trajectory.description: Continues leading MEE6 as Co-CEO from Paris, operating in 5 countries with a philosophy of validating features against real user behavior before investing development time.
